title: DuplexGen: Adaptive Synthesis of Human-AI Turn-Taking Dialogues
abstract: arXiv:2607.26178v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Turn-taking is a central component of full-duplex interaction. Which turn-taking behaviors are appropriate varies with the scenario, yet current models apply a single norm regardless of context. This limitation originates in their training data: human-human speech corpora capture natural timing phenomena but provide little role grounding or scenario-specific norms, while heuristic or prompted synthesis methods inject turn-taking behaviors without basing them on human preferences. We introduce DuplexGen, a framework for generating dialogues with scenario-adaptive turn-taking by calibrating LLM predictions against a small set of slot-level human preference annotations. translated_title: DuplexGen：人机轮替对话的自适应合成
translated_abstract: 轮替（turn-taking）是全双工交互的核心组成部分。哪些轮替行为是恰当的会因场景而异，然而当前模型无论情境如何都采用单一的规范。这一局限源于其训练数据：人与人之间的语音语料虽然捕捉了自然的时机现象，却几乎没有提供角色定位或特定场景的规范；而启发式或基于提示的合成方法虽然注入了轮替行为，却没有以人类偏好为基础。我们提出了DuplexGen，一个通过利用少量槽位级的人类偏好标注来校准大语言模型预测，从而生成具有场景自适应轮替行为对话的框架。在六项合作与竞争任务中，人类的轮替偏好存在系统性差异，DuplexGen与这些偏好的对齐程度显著高于未经校准的提示方法或仅使用通用人-人对话数据训练的模型；一个基于……训练的全双工模型……
tldr: DuplexGen通过少量槽位级人类轮替偏好标注校准大语言模型，生成能根据合作或竞争等不同场景自适应调整轮替行为的对话数据，其对齐人类偏好的程度显著优于未校准提示和仅用通用人-人语料训练的方法。
en_tdlr: DuplexGen calibrates LLM dialogue generation with a small set of slot-level human turn-taking preference annotations, enabling scenario-adaptive turn-taking behaviors that align substantially better with human preferences across cooperative and competitive tasks than uncalibrated prompting or training solely on generic human-human data.
